command: Daphnia pulex DpuGr29 (E9FXF3) participates in male courtship behavior and has ligand-gated cation channel activity. Assess the inherited behavioral annotation and an existing reviewer-added channel proposal separately. PMID:19383158 places this receptor in an expanded Daphnia gustatory-receptor clade; known insect cuticular-hydrocarbon receptors can belong to different lineages. Inspect PTN001080220 placement and compare experimental ligand/channel/behavior evidence without imposing an insect-only taxon restriction on courtship. Broad chemosensory family membership alone does not establish a particular ligand, behavioral role, or demonstrated channel chemistry.
